paragraphs: R. Azaryah of Kefar Ḥanan, in R. Yose bar Ḥanina's time—I did not find it. R. Abba bar Kahana and R. Ḥanan both in R. Azaryah of Kefar Ḥatya's name, Vayikra Rabbah, Tzav 7.
